findings.finding: No runtime HrisExplorerAuthorityEvidenceQuery implementation exists, so the enabled Explorer surface fails closed with 503 for every request.
No runtime HrisPlatformReceiptAuthoritySource implementation exists, so the preserved platform-origin SYS-API-038 profile is never readable.

Reference configuration and navigation policy commands still write only their V325/V326 legacy receipt tables; a safe UNION is impossible because those rows do not seal all current route, subject, population, field, purpose and authorization context.
SYS-API-038 transport purpose was incorrectly fixed to HRIS_APP_DISCOVERY even though COMMAND_STATUS is the read purpose and the sealed originating command purpose varies by producer.
Recent-item writes with different idempotency keys were not serialized on one tenant-principal aggregate and could exceed the maximum of 20 rows.

transportPurpose.rule: The receipt read request purpose is COMMAND_STATUS. It is not copied into the immutable receipt origin purpose.

originPurpose.integration: Preserve the profile but return opaque 404 until a real integration producer writes a canonical sealed receipt; synthetic rows and inferred backfill are forbidden.

canonicalReceiptSeal.publicSchemaRule: The fields are internal authorization evidence and do not expand HrisCommandReceiptV1 or HrisExplorerReceiptV1.
canonicalReceiptSeal.immutabilityRule: All original and successor seal fields are immutable after insert.
canonicalReceiptSeal.backfillRule: Do not synthesize or infer missing origin context for V325/V326 historical rows. Historical rows remain available only through their existing owner-local behavior and are not exposed through SYS-API-038.

producerRule.referenceConfiguration: Within the existing successful command transaction, preserve the V325 receipt and atomically insert one canonical sealed receipt with the same public receipt ID and result semantics.
producerRule.navigationPolicy: Within the existing successful command transaction, preserve the V326 receipt and atomically insert one canonical sealed receipt with the same public receipt ID and result semantics.
producerRule.replayRule: An exact legacy idempotent replay returns the existing response and must not attempt a second canonical insert; digest mismatch remains side-effect free.
producerRule.rollbackRule: If either legacy or canonical insert fails, the command transaction rolls back.

currentAuthorityRule.explorer: Use a concrete server-side Explorer authority adapter. It must bind tenant, actor and subject, call trusted current product authorization for exact deployed PAGE routes, validate current context/scope/field/purpose/revisions and expiry, and never accept browser role or route lists as authority.
currentAuthorityRule.platformReceipt: Use a concrete server-side current-authority adapter. It must re-evaluate the exact SYS-API-038 route and verify the sealed subject, origin route, context, scope, population digest, field revision, origin purpose and authorization revision. A changed context that cannot be proven equal or more restrictive fails closed with opaque 404.
currentAuthorityRule.actorRule: Both authority ports include the authenticated actor ID; subject public ID alone is insufficient for Auth evaluation.
currentAuthorityRule.headerRule: Gateway/service headers are inputs only after constant-time service identity verification and exact single-value validation; the adapters still perform server-side current-authority resolution.

stalePresentationRule.serverAuthority: Expired or stale route, scope, field or owner evidence is never admitted, including ALLOW_STALE.
stalePresentationRule.providerFailure: Missing, stale, mismatched, timed-out or unavailable owner provider evidence is omitted and produces PARTIAL.
stalePresentationRule.uiState: The required stale UI state means a previously successful response is visibly retained while a refresh/revalidation failed or expired; it does not authorize stale server data and need not make ProjectionState.STALE reachable from expired authority.

correctedSemantics.recentsConcurrencyRule: All recent-item mutations for one tenant-principal are serialized on one aggregate lock before upsert and trim, independent of Idempotency-Key.
